name: Viktor Petrov
about_me: I'm Viktor, a senior software engineer at GM in Warren working on vehicle software. I mentor students and I want to start angel investing in mobility and robotics. Looking for founders and co-investors.
goals: Make my first two angel investments in mobility

debriefs.text: Chen Wei, my colleague in autonomy at GM, is thinking of leaving to start a warehouse robotics company. He wants co-founders.
Met Wes Bradley at A2 Launchpad. He's an angel and former HR-tech founder who runs Friday office hours and offered to let me sit in to learn.
Talked to Ben Hartley, engineering manager at Routewise. They're raising a Series A soon.
Keisha Morrow from Maize Launch asked me to judge demo day in April.

card.headline: GM engineer, new angel
card.about: Vehicle software engineer investing in mobility.
